  1017	class _CommitCloseConnection:
  1018	    """Pass-through real connection; close only after successful actual COMMIT."""
  1019	
  1020	    def __init__(self, connection, trigger):
  1021	        self.connection = connection
  1022	        self.trigger = trigger
  1023	
  1024	    def __getattr__(self, name):
  1025	        return getattr(self.connection, name)
  1026	
  1027	    def execute(self, sql, *args, **kwargs):
  1028	        value = self.connection.execute(sql, *args, **kwargs)
  1029	        if sql == "COMMIT":
  1030	            self.trigger(self.connection)
  1031	        return value
